hints.tr: Parantez içine bir `SELECT` yazabiliyorsun ve sonucu sabit bir değer gibi kullanılıyor.
hints.en: You can write a `SELECT` inside parentheses, and its result is used like a constant.

hints.tr: `WHERE price > (SELECT AVG(price) FROM products)` — içerideki sorgu tek bir sayı üretiyor.
hints.en: `WHERE price > (SELECT AVG(price) FROM products)` — the inner query produces a single number.

hints.tr:
Sorgunun tamamı:

```sql
SELECT name, price
FROM products
WHERE price > (SELECT AVG(price) FROM products)
ORDER BY price DESC;
```
hints.en:
The whole query:

```sql
SELECT name, price
FROM products
WHERE price > (SELECT AVG(price) FROM products)
ORDER BY price DESC;
```
